output: Hypothesis: There is a statistically significant difference in degree completion rates between males and females in the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79) dataset. The context of this hypothesis is the relationship between gender and educational attainment. The variables chosen are "Sex of respondent, 1979" (gender) and "Highest grade completed, 1979" (degree completion rates). The analysis revealed a significant difference in the mean degree completion rates between males and females, with a t-statistic of -5.69 and a p-value of approximately 1.29 × 10⁻⁸, indicating a statistically significant relationship.
